description: This file defines a Flask-based REST API endpoint for retrieving aggregated analytics data, including counts of users, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions. It uses Flask-Smorest for route and schema management, and includes a role-based decorator for access control.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummarySchema
classes.description: Schema describing the analytics summary response, including total counts for users, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: REST API resource providing an endpoint to obtain aggregated analytics data for admin and HR dashboards.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve summary counts of various analytics metrics from the database, returning a JSON response with the data.

ctags.name: assignments

ctags.pattern: /^    users = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of users (profiles)")$/
